sh settings put global hide_error_dialogs 1
sh am broadcast -a android.intent.action.CLOSE_SYSTEM_DIALOGS >/dev/null
sh am force-stop com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox
sh am force-stop com.android.chrome
sh am force-stop com.brave.browser
stop
wait 2
launch
wait 20
taploop (?i)^(skip|allow|ok|while using the app|only this time|continue|get started|not now|got it|next|done)$
shot 30-home-relaunch
sh logcat -d -s DirectBilling
